id: title:Piccirello:improve staff login lookup for widget tickets

review.abstention_reason: The chunk lacks backend implementation, database, and API changes required to establish identity verification and impersonation prevention mechanisms. Frontend-only changes cannot demonstrate the reliability or systemic risk reduction needed for a score of 3, nor can they independently establish a score of 2 without backend support. No tier can be assigned.
review.posthog_relevance: Support ticket impersonation prevention and identity verification, but implementation is incomplete.
review.reason: Only frontend TypeScript and comments are present; backend identity verification and shared identity-layer implementation are missing, preventing assignment of a tier.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of getImpersonationTicketContext, backend identity verification, or widget-specific channel handling. Without these, the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of getImpersonationTicketContext, the backend identity verification and the widget-specific channel handling. The frontend and backend changes are incomplete, so the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds typed fields isEmailUnverified and verifiedDistinctId to ImpersonationTicketContext.
observations.posthog_connection: These fields support distinguishing between an email supplied by a form and a server-attested identity, which is required for the widget-specific identity verification. Without the backend implementation, this is not a complete change.

observations.behavior: Changes the login URL query parameter to use the verified identity rather than the supplied email.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent account lookup failures when the supplied email does not match the account, but the backend identity verification and the widget-specific channel handling are not shown, so the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for the verified identity and the supplied email, and uses the verified identity for the login URL.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent account lookup failures when the supplied email does not match the account, but the backend identity verification and the widget-specific channel handling are not shown, so the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend TypeScript implementation for the Support Ticket scene. It does not provide backend, database, or API implementation, so it cannot establish the reliability, identity verification, or impersonation prevention mechanisms described in the comments. The tier cannot be assigned without backend or shared identity-layer implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds a new TypeScript type and a helper function to extract ticket context, including an attested identity and email verification status, replacing a previous inline context construction.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports the frontend display of impersonation warnings and identity verification status for support tickets, relying on backend-provided identity and channel metadata.
